item.title: Why Not Fly to Japan and Get a JDM-Spec Vintage Land Cruiser?
item.description: San Diego's Flex Automotive will let you pick up a new-to-you JDM Land Cruiser in Japan as part of a weeklong experience.

item.title: What's the Average Life of a Hybrid Car's Battery?
item.description: High-voltage batteries are expensive to replace. How long can you expect yours to last?

item.title: The Enzo Ferrari 1956 Peugeot 403 from the Ferrari Movie Is on Bring a Trailer
item.description: Adam Driver, playing Enzo Ferrari, drove this Peugeot in the feature film.

item.title: If Your Subaru SUV Has 'Wilderness' in the Name, We're Pretty Sure You've Got a Dog
item.description: Subaru already appeals strongly to people who love pets. The Outback, Forester, and Crosstrek Wilderness buyers are the really impressive statistic.

item.title: Toyota's Off-Road-Ready Sequoia EMT Rig Is for Emergency-Use Only
item.description: Toyota added a suspension lift and emergency lights to turn a former test vehicle into a first responder for its Arizona Proving Grounds.

item.title: EPA Says It's 'Killing' Stop-Start, and Here's What Automakers Have to Say
item.description: We contacted automakers for their take on this hot-button issue (no pun intended) and got some surprising responses.

item.title: Filmmaker John Sayles Turns His Attention to Henry Ford and Detroit with 'Crucible'
item.description: The historical novel recounts a pivotal time for the company, the city, and the auto industry.

item.title: View Photos of the 1994 Saab 900SE
item.description: See the interior and exterior of the 1994 Saab 900SE from every angle.

item.title: Tested: 1994 Saab 900SE Is No Swedish Skylark
item.description: Despite the British V-6, it's a Trollhättan troll, through and through.

item.title: A Very Special Studebaker Avanti Will Be on Display in L.A.
item.description: This supercharged 1963 Avanti R2 was once personally owned by designer Raymond Loewy.
